title: Verify ASCII Report button label on Word Report tab
steps: Open Reports and select the Word Report (Plots in word Report) tab.
Locate the ASCII Report action button in the report buttons row.
Read the visible button label text.
expected_results: Word Report tab is active.
ASCII Report button is visible.
Button label displays 'ASCII Report' not 'Download ASCII Report'.
label: Critical

title: Verify ASCII Report button label on Material Usage tab
steps: Open Reports and select the Material Usage tab.
Locate the ASCII Report button.
Read the visible button label.
expected_results: Material Usage tab is active.
ASCII Report button is visible.
Button label displays 'ASCII Report'.
label: Standard

title: Verify ASCII Report button label on Post Job Data tab
steps: Open Reports and select the Post Job Data tab.
Locate the ASCII Report button.
Read the visible button label.
expected_results: Post Job Data tab is active.
ASCII Report button is visible.
Button label displays 'ASCII Report'.
label: Standard

title: Verify clicking ASCII Report opens dialog without invoking COMMAND API
steps: On any Reports tab click the ASCII Report button once.
Monitor network/API for COMMAND or GenerateASCII invocation on click.
Observe whether the ASCII Report modal opens.
expected_results: Button click is accepted.
No COMMAND/GenerateASCII API call occurs on button click alone.
ASCII Report modal dialog opens via onOpenAsciiReportDialog.
label: Critical

title: Verify ASCII Report modal dialog title and layout
steps: Click ASCII Report on Reports.
Inspect modal header title and overall dialog structure.
Confirm modal is centered and sized appropriately.
expected_results: Modal opens.
Dialog title shows 'ASCII Report'.
Modal presents tab area and action buttons at bottom.
label: Standard

title: Verify Real-time tab is present and active by default in ASCII dialog
steps: Open the ASCII Report dialog.
Inspect tab labels and active tab state.
Confirm Real-time channel spreadsheet is shown.
expected_results: Dialog opens.
Real-time and FracPro tabs are visible.
Real-time tab is active by default with channel selection grid.
label: Standard

title: Verify FracPro tab switches channel list in ASCII dialog
steps: Open the ASCII Report dialog.
Click the FracPro tab.
Inspect the channel selection grid content.
expected_results: Dialog opens on Real-time tab.
FracPro tab becomes active.
FracPro channel spreadsheet is displayed (AC note says FrPro; UI label is FracPro).
label: Standard

title: Verify Generate and Cancel action buttons are present in ASCII dialog
steps: Open the ASCII Report dialog.
Inspect footer action buttons.
Confirm button labels.
expected_results: Dialog opens.
Cancel and Generate buttons are visible.
Cancel uses translated CANCEL label; Generate shows 'Generate'.
label: Standard

title: Verify Cancel dismisses ASCII dialog without saving reportSetup changes
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and change Real-time channel selections.
Click Cancel.
Reopen ASCII dialog and compare selections to saved state before changes.
expected_results: Channel selections were changed in dialog.
Dialog closes on Cancel.
Reopened dialog shows prior saved selections; unsaved dialog edits were discarded.
label: Standard

title: Verify close X dismisses ASCII dialog without saving changes
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and toggle FracPro channel selections.
Click the header close (X) control.
Reopen dialog and verify selections were not persisted from cancelled session.
expected_results: Selections were changed.
Dialog closes via X without save.
Prior saved channel selections are restored on reopen.
label: Standard

title: Verify Generate saves changed channel selection then starts ASCII generation
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and change Real-time and/or FracPro channel selections.
Click Generate.
Monitor updateReportSetup call and subsequent COMMAND/GenerateASCII flow.
expected_results: Selections are modified.
updateReportSetup is called with asciirealtime/asciifp when selection changed.
Dialog closes and ASCII generation COMMAND flow starts after successful save.
label: Critical

title: Verify Generate with unchanged selections still closes dialog and runs COMMAND
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog without changing any channel selections.
Click Generate.
Observe whether updateReportSetup is skipped and COMMAND still runs.
expected_results: Dialog opens with current saved selections.
Generate closes dialog without updateReportSetup when selection unchanged.
startAsciiCommand still invokes GenerateASCII COMMAND path.
label: Standard

title: Verify Real-time channel list loads with selectable checkboxes
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog on Real-time tab.
Wait for loading skeleton to complete.
Inspect channel rows and Select checkboxes.
expected_results: Loading state completes.
Real-time channels populate in spreadsheet.
Each row has Channel name and Select checkbox.
label: Standard

title: Verify FracPro channel list loads with selectable checkboxes
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and switch to FracPro tab.
Wait for channel data to load.
Toggle individual channel Select checkboxes.
expected_results: FracPro tab shows channel grid after load.
Channels are listed with Select checkboxes.
Individual checkbox toggles update row selection state.
label: Standard

title: Verify select-all toggles all Real-time channels in ASCII dialog
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog on Real-time tab with multiple channels.
Use select-all in the Select column header.
Confirm all Real-time rows reflect the select-all state.
expected_results: Multiple Real-time channels are listed.
Select-all control is available.
All Real-time channel checkboxes match select-all on/off state.
label: Standard

title: Verify failed reportSetup update shows error and does not start COMMAND
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and change channel selections.
Simulate or observe updateReportSetup API failure on Generate.
Confirm dialog behavior and COMMAND not started.
expected_results: Selection changes are made.
Error toast 'Failed to update ASCII channel selection' is shown.
GenerateASCII COMMAND does not start; dialog remains or user can retry.
label: Standard

title: Verify Operator role cannot click ASCII Report button
steps: Log in as Operator user and open Reports.
Attempt to click the ASCII Report button.
Observe disabled state and pointer behavior.
expected_results: Reports page loads for Operator.
ASCII Report button is disabled with reduced opacity.
Click does not open dialog or start generation.
label: Standard

title: Verify Download Word Report button still works after ASCII dialog cancel
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and Cancel.
Click Download Word Report.
Confirm Word report generation flow still initiates.
expected_results: ASCII dialog cancelled cleanly.
Word Report button is clickable.
Word report download/generation flow works without regression.
label: Regression

title: Verify Download WITSML Report button still works after ASCII dialog flow
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog, change selections, Generate or Cancel.
Click Download WITSML Report.
Confirm WITSML generation still works.
expected_results: ASCII interaction completes.
WITSML button remains enabled when applicable.
WITSML report flow works without regression.
label: Regression

title: Verify Save button on Reports still works after ASCII dialog interaction
steps: Make a report change on Material Usage tab.
Open and Cancel ASCII Report dialog.
Click Save on Reports.
expected_results: Pending report edits exist.
ASCII dialog cancelled.
Save still triggers report save workflow without regression.
label: Regression

title: Verify ASCII dialog shows loading skeleton while channels are fetched
steps: Click ASCII Report on a well/treatment with channel data.
Observe dialog immediately after open before data loads.
Confirm skeleton transitions to channel grid.
expected_results: Dialog opens quickly.
Placeholder skeleton rows appear during isLoading.
Channel spreadsheet replaces skeleton when data is ready.
label: Regression

title: Verify ASCII dialog Cancel is disabled while reportSetup update is in progress
steps: Open ASCII Report dialog and change channel selections.
Click Generate to trigger updateReportSetup.
While isGenerating attempt Cancel or close X.
expected_results: Generate starts save path.
Cancel and close controls are disabled during isGenerating.
Document behavior: user cannot cancel mid-save (potential UX gap vs AC close-anytime expectation).
label: Regression

title: Verify ASCII Report flow on Material Usage tab preserves Import from XOPS button
steps: Select Material Usage tab on Reports.
Confirm Import from XOPS button is visible alongside ASCII Report.
Open and Cancel ASCII dialog; verify Import from XOPS still works.
expected_results: Material Usage tab shows both buttons.
ASCII dialog opens and closes normally.
Import from XOPS remains available and functional.
label: Regression

title: Verify default Real-time selection uses all channels when no saved asciirealtime exists
steps: Use a well with no prior ASCII Real-time selection saved in reportSetup.
Open ASCII Report dialog on Real-time tab.
Inspect initial checkbox states.
expected_results: Report setup has empty/null asciirealtime.
Dialog loads Real-time channels.
All Real-time channels are selected by default per implementation.
label: Regression

title: Verify default FracPro selection is none when no saved asciifp exists
steps: Use a well with no prior FracPro ASCII selection in reportSetup.
Open ASCII Report dialog and switch to FracPro tab.
Inspect initial checkbox states.
expected_results: Report setup has empty/null asciifp.
FracPro channels load in grid.
FracPro channels are unchecked by default per implementation.
